options.name: a10_device_context_id
options.description: Device ID for aVCS configuration

options.name: a10_partition
options.description: Destination/target partition for object/command

options.name: add
options.description: Slow start connection limit add by a number every interval (Add by this number every interval)

options.name: ansible_host
options.description: Host for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_password
options.description: Password for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_port
options.description: Port for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_username
options.description: Username for AXAPI authentication

options.name: bw_rate_limit
options.description: Configure bandwidth rate limit on real server (Bandwidth rate limit in Kbps)

options.name: bw_rate_limit_acct
options.description: 'to-server-only'= Only account for traffic sent to server; 'from-server-only'= Only account for traffic received from server; 'all'= Account for all traffic sent to and received from server;

options.name: bw_rate_limit_duration
options.description: Duration in seconds the observed rate needs to honor

options.name: bw_rate_limit_no_logging
options.description: Do not log bandwidth rate limit related state transitions

options.name: bw_rate_limit_resume
options.description: Resume server selection after bandwidth drops below this threshold (in Kbps) (Bandwidth rate limit resume threshold (in Kbps))

options.name: conn_limit
options.description: Connection limit

options.name: conn_limit_no_logging
options.description: Do not log connection over limit event

options.name: conn_rate_limit
options.description: Connection rate limit

options.name: conn_rate_limit_no_logging
options.description: Do not log connection over limit event

options.name: dns_fail_interval
options.description: The interval to retry when DNS failed to query (DNS failure interval (in second, default is 30))

options.name: dns_query_interval
options.description: The interval to query DNS server for the hostname (DNS query interval (in minute, default is 10))

options.name: dynamic_server_prefix
options.description: Prefix of dynamic server (Prefix of dynamic server (default is 'DRS'))

options.name: every
options.description: Slow start connection limit increment interval (default 10)

options.name: extended_stats
options.description: Enable extended statistics on real server

options.name: health_check
options.description: Health Check Monitor (Health monitor name)

options.name: health_check_disable
options.description: Disable configured health check configuration

options.name: initial_slow_start
options.description: Initial slow start connection limit (default 128)

options.name: log_selection_failure
options.description: Enable real-time logging for server selection failure event

options.name: max_dynamic_server
options.description: Maximum dynamic server number (Maximum dynamic server number (default is 255))

options.name: min_ttl_ratio
options.description: Minimum TTL to DNS query interval ratio (Minimum TTL ratio (default is 2))

options.name: name
options.description: Server template name

options.name: rate_interval
options.description: '100ms'= Use 100 ms as sampling interval; 'second'= Use 1 second as sampling interval;

options.name: resume
options.description: Resume accepting new connection after connection number drops below threshold (Connection resume threshold)

options.name: slow_start
options.description: Slowly ramp up the connection number after server is up

options.name: spoofing_cache
options.description: Servers under the template are spoofing cache

options.name: state
options.description: State of the object to be created.

options.name: stats_data_action
options.description: 'stats-data-enable'= Enable statistical data collection for real server; 'stats-data-disable'= Disable statistical data collection for real server;

options.name: till
options.description: Slow start ends when slow start connection limit reaches a number (default 4096) (Slow start ends when connection limit reaches this number)

options.name: times
options.description: Slow start connection limit multiply by a number every interval (default 2) (Multiply by this number every interval)

options.name: user_tag
options.description: Customized tag

options.name: uuid
options.description: uuid of the object

options.name: weight
options.description: Weight for the Real Servers (Connection Weight (default is 1))
